estilo: Use the attached image ONLY as the style and character reference. Draw a NEW single-panel cartoon illustration in exactly the same style: bright flat colors, thick black outlines, friendly comic look, the same young hiker character (red beanie with white pompom, brown hair, friendly face), mountain background with pine trees, blue sky and clouds, rounded white panel border. Vertical format. One single scene, no multiple panels, no logos, no watermark, no signature. Any text must be in Spanish, short, large and spelled exactly as given.

imagenes.prompt: Scene: the hiker on a sunny mountain trail, wearing only a tight-fitting dark blue technical base-layer t-shirt and hiking trousers. Small blue arrows show sweat moving out from the skin through the fabric and evaporating. The hiker looks dry and comfortable. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "CAPA 1 · TÉRMICA". A small tag next to the shirt reads: "saca el sudor".

Scene: the hiker on a cool, windy mountain ridge in autumn, wearing an orange fleece jacket over the base layer. Small wavy warm lines around the body show trapped warm air. The hiker looks warm and content. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "CAPA 2 · AISLANTE". A small tag next to the fleece reads: "guarda el calor".

Scene: the hiker walking in heavy rain and strong wind on a mountain path, wearing a bright red waterproof shell jacket with the hood up. Raindrops bounce off the jacket, wind lines hit it and are deflected. The hiker smiles, dry inside. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "CAPA 3 · PROTECTORA". A small tag next to the jacket reads: "frena lluvia y viento".

Scene: the hiker sitting on a rock at a snowy summit during a rest stop, wearing a puffy yellow down jacket, holding a steaming thermos cup. Snow on the ground, cold blue sky. The hiker looks cosy. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "CAPA 4 · PLUMÍFERO". A small tag next to the jacket reads: "para las paradas".

Scene: the hiker on a cold windy mountain, wearing a plain grey cotton t-shirt soaked with sweat (dark wet patches), shivering, teeth chattering, blue-ish face, small ice crystals and cold wind lines around. A big red X badge in the corner. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "ERROR · ALGODÓN". A small tag reads: "mojado = frío".

Scene: the hiker walking steeply uphill on a sunny mountain path while wearing a thick puffy down jacket fully zipped, red face, sweating heavily with big sweat drops, steam rising from the head, looking exhausted. A big red X badge in the corner. A big rounded label at the top reads exactly: "ERROR · SUDAR". A small tag reads: "quítate capas al subir".
